# Thales Everardo — Staff Software Engineer & Systems Architect

> Interactive Systems Architecture & Observability Portfolio: https://thaleseverardo.github.io/thales-everardo-cv/

## Professional Overview
Systems Architect and Staff Software Engineer with over 10 years of production experience specializing in high-throughput data engineering, distributed microservices, fault-tolerant computing, and event-driven architectures (EDA). Expert in eliminating mission-critical latencies in enterprise transactional environments under strict ACID compliance.

- Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Open to Global Remote, Hybrid SP, and International Relocation)
- GitHub: https://github.com/thaleseverardo
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/thaleseverardo
- Primary Stack: C#, .NET Core, T-SQL, SQL Server, Sybase, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Python, TypeScript, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux Architecture

## Core Production Engineering Milestones
1. Consórcio Magalu (05/2024 - Present): Partitioned asynchronous purge of 11TB legacy transaction logs on SQL Server without lock escalations or production downtime during fiscal reconciliations.
2. Grupo GPS (06/2023 - 05/2024): Slashed financial computation pipeline latency from 7 days down to 20 minutes (-99.8% latency reduction) with full consistency through clustered table partitioning, deep query tuning, and async parallelization in C#.
3. Ambar / Construtech (07/2021 - 06/2023): Real-time synchronization of catalogs and inventories across 5 distribution centers with zero order loss using GS1 standard messaging and Transactional Outbox pattern backed by RabbitMQ.
4. Summerhill / Eco Wave (11/2019 - 06/2021): Geographic heuristic route optimization engine for field technicians with offline-first synchronization, lowering operational travel costs by 22%.
5. Military Police of São Paulo State (02/2014 - 11/2019): High-availability automated failover architecture for emergency 911/190 dispatch centers with 99.99% uptime, active-active relational clustering, and dynamic SIP/VoIP carrier failover.
